## About
Anytime truck and trailer repair is a commercial vehicle shop on Marigold Dr in Dallas. We built our workshop to keep our own fleet in good shape, and we open the same bays to outside drivers and companies.
Inside you will find a hall set up for maintenance and repairs of trucks and trailers. We handle safety inspections, general inspections, exhaust emission tests and hydraulic repairs, and we keep our own tire warehouse stocked with the most common sizes.
Our goal is simple: help you run your business by getting your truck fixed and back on the road.

## Services
- Truck and trailer maintenance and repair: General maintenance and repair work for trucks, trailers and commercial vehicles in our workshop hall.
- Inspections, emission tests and hydraulic repairs: Safety inspections, general inspections, exhaust emission tests and hydraulic repair work.
- Tires, rims and wheels: We are happy to advise you on tires, rims or complete wheels for your truck and trailer.
- Transmission, oil change and batteries: One reviewer had transmission work, an oil change and new batteries done here.
- AC service: One reviewer brought their truck in to get the AC serviced and was back on the road with cold air.
- DEF system and clutch: A reviewer mentioned we work on DEF systems and clutches as well.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on trailers too?
A: Yes. Our workshop handles maintenance and repairs for both trucks and trailers.

Q: Can you fix tire tread damage?
A: Yes. We repair minor damage to the tire tread right in the workshop.

Q: Are you open on the weekend?
A: On Saturday we are open from 8:00 AM to 2:00 PM. On Sunday we are closed.
